extensionPolicy: APEX 26.2 uses a separate extension catalog and separate evidence; never mix its results into this baseline.
performanceBudgetPolicy: Initial diagnostic budgets, not a vendor SLA or qualified benchmark. Less than 20 samples cannot qualify p95.

cases.title: MCP startup and ten-tool discovery
steps: List tools through real stdio MCP.
expected: Exactly ten unique supported tools; removed controllers absent.

cases.title: Doctor and compiler prerequisites
steps: Run status doctor.
expected: Node, Java and SQLcl are detected; no database call or automatic download.

cases.title: Concise project inspection
steps: Inspect summary three times.
expected: Correct app/environment; bounded summary; no DB call.

cases.title: Saved SQLcl connection identity
steps: Test the connection selected from test.env.
expected: Exact database, service and parsing schema match configuration.

cases.title: Batched live application, pages and release
steps: Read three metadata requests in one batch.
expected: App identity matches; pages exist; real APEX release is 26.1.x; target verified once.

cases.title: Scoped metadata pagination
steps: Read pages with limit 1; repeat with returned offset.
expected: No duplicate/missing IDs on a stable target; untrusted classification retained.

cases.title: Foreign schema rejection
steps: Request OTHER_SCHEMA.
expected: SCHEMA_DENIED before Oracle query.

cases.title: Missing object rejection
steps: Read columns without a name.
expected: OBJECT_REQUIRED before Oracle query.

cases.title: APEXlang reference search
steps: Search page with version 26.1, limit 3.
expected: Nonempty bounded release-specific results.

cases.title: Component reference search

expected: Nonempty source-backed component results.

cases.title: Pattern reference search

expected: Nonempty source-backed pattern results.

cases.title: Composer block discovery

expected: Compatible block results; evidence scope explicit.

cases.title: Composer blueprint discovery

expected: CRM blueprint discoverable without DB write.

cases.title: Bounded reference read
steps: Read the selected grammar page ID with limit 512.
expected: Nonempty paginated content; read continuation is deterministic.

cases.title: Local sync status
steps: Read existing working-copy status.
expected: Local checkpoint state reported without DB query.

cases.title: Live baseline adoption and durable backup
steps: Initialize working copy through a queued job; wait on that job.
expected: Read-only full APEXlang baseline, .apex/MMD and checksummed backup retained.

cases.title: Real Oracle source validation
steps: Validate adopted 26.1 application with Oracle compiler.
expected: No compiler errors; advisory CodeScan is separate.

cases.title: Read-only full-import plan
steps: Plan full import; inspect sources, identity, risks and expiration.
expected: Source/target/lock-bound plan; no DB writes.

cases.title: Authorized no-op application ship
steps: Apply unchanged adopted baseline using literal user request.
expected: No-op verified; grant removed; no unrelated business/auth changes.

cases.title: Browser URL handoff
steps: Call browser_open without browser controls.
expected: Correct configured URL; explicitly not UI verification.

cases.title: Missing job rejection
steps: Query nonexistent job UUID.
expected: JOB_NOT_FOUND; no new worker spawned.

cases.title: Missing artifact rejection
steps: Read unknown artifact ID.
expected: Registered-artifact-only access; no file/path disclosure.

cases.title: Native host lifecycle and relocated installation

expected: Record native discovery/version and actual tool result separately from subprocess checks.
evidence: sanitized result and server postcondition where applicable

expected: Existing settings/plugins/runtime/projects preserved; no hidden download or bypass.

cases.title: Compiler syntax error and recovery

expected: Server readback matches each marker; all other files/auth/DB inventory unchanged; grants revoked.

cases.title: Local source mutation after plan

cases.title: Real target drift and conflict

expected: First runner detects target drift and refuses stale apply; no silent replacement.

cases.title: Concurrent runners and foreign ownership

evidence: sanitized result and server postcondition where applicable

cases.title: Unknown outcome and server-first recovery

expected: Already-applied result requires zero reimport; no blind SQL replay; foreign/live owner preserved.

cases.title: Job status, waits and cancellation

expected: Bounded waits reuse worker; no duplicate work; cancellation never claims Oracle rollback.

cases.title: Working-copy invalidation/refresh and restart

expected: Durable state consistent; local edits and unknown outcomes block destructive refresh.
evidence: sanitized result and server postcondition where applicable

cases.title: Complete eight-kind metadata and pagination

expected: Journaled changes, ownership, identical repeat no-op, conflicts retain local bytes; real compiler validates complete scaffolds.

expected: Real committed atomic API results and UI behavior; positive/negative evidence; fixture data cleanup reviewed.

cases.title: Performance cold/warm and model agent evaluation
steps: Repeat fixed dataset/query/page-edit scenarios >=20 times after one warm-up; run one fresh MCP process per cold sample; compare same-machine baseline and exact model/config.
expected: Median/p95/max, call counts, bytes, errors, retries and actual host token deltas; quality pass required before speed comparison.
evidence: sanitized result and server postcondition where applicable

cases.title: Packaging, provenance, docs and release gates
steps: Run build/typecheck/lint/contracts/packaging/docs/plugin/site checks; inspect readiness without publish.
expected: Current hashes and honest blockers; missing external evidence stays missing; no automatic application test runner.
evidence: sanitized result and server postcondition where applicable

cases.title: Secret exposure and private ENV parsing
steps: Use secret sentinels in repository fixtures; parse test.env literally; inspect sanitized evidence, CLI arguments and tracked files.
expected: No secret echo/source/substitution, no credentials in args/reports/Git; test.env ignored.
evidence: sanitized result and server postcondition where applicable

cases.title: 26.1 release isolation and unsupported selected import
steps: Check source/compiler profile; on copied sources request explicit file mode on 26.1; use 26.1 references only.
expected: Unsupported partial import refused with no full fallback; 26.2 functionality is not claimed.
evidence: sanitized result and server postcondition where applicable

cases.title: Connected session budget per read operation
steps: With debugTimings, call connection_test, a three-kind metadata batch, one single metadata read, a full-import plan and sync status.
Count sqlclTimings records per call by connected/offline, reused and mutation flags.
expected: Metadata batch and single read: exactly 1 connected session each.
Plan: 1 connected session plus at most 1 reused offline compiler session.
connection_test: 1 connected session; sync status: 0 connected sessions.
Every record has mutation=false and contains no SQL, bindings or credentials.
evidence: MCP call count and response bytes

cases.title: Measured working-copy apply latency and phase split
steps: Use the A261-028 title-marker change on the identified test application.
Run 1 excluded warm-up and 10 measured validate/plan/apply cycles; restart MCP after cycle 5.
Record journal phase timings, sqlclTimings and job observation count per cycle.
Restore the original title through a fresh ship and run the independent byte audit.
expected: Every cycle: confirmed import, server readback matches the marker and the grant is removed.
Connected sessions per apply are 4 when the read and deploy connections match.
Median and p95 are reported against the 3-sample baseline (53.1 s median); the P1 estimate stays labeled as an estimate.
Final audit is byte-identical to the initial backup.
evidence: MCP call count and response bytes

cases.title: Per-kind metadata latency
steps: Read each of the eight metadata kinds alone, 20 samples plus 1 excluded warm-up each.
Read one batch with all eight kinds, 20 samples.
Record statement-level execute time between batch markers.
expected: Per-kind median/p95 and statement time are reported; the slowest kind is named.
Batch time is about one session cost plus the sum of statement times; any gap is reported.
A statement median above 3 s is flagged for SQL review (diagnostic, not a failure).
evidence: MCP call count and response bytes

cases.title: Warm connected read-session reuse
steps: Run 20 sequential applications+pages metadata batches inside the pool TTL.
Pause longer than the idle-probe interval, then run one more batch.
Run one apply-plan call so the mutation path is observed (plan only).
expected: First call reused=false; following calls reused=true.
Warm median at most 1 s; the identity query still runs in every operation.
After the pause, an idle probe precedes the batch.
Any mutation-flagged batch uses a fresh session.
evidence: MCP call count and response bytes
cases.prerequisite: Connected read-only session pooling (P2) is implemented; otherwise record not_run with that reason.

cases.title: Reused-session state isolation
steps: Through a development adapter script, run batch 1 that changes NLS_DATE_FORMAT, current_schema, sqlformat, serveroutput and dbms_application_info module.
Run batch 2 on the same pooled key and read back those settings.
Repeat with batch 1 ending in an ORA error.
expected: Batch 2 observes neutral settings, or the session was replaced.
An ORA/SP2/PLS error kills the session; the next call starts fresh.
No DML, DDL or commit is issued.
evidence: sanitized result code and server postcondition where applicable
cases.prerequisite: Connected read-only session pooling (P2) is implemented; otherwise record not_run with that reason.

cases.title: Concurrent read-only operations
steps: From one MCP process, start 4 metadata batches with different kinds, 1 plan and 1 validate in parallel; repeat 10 rounds.
expected: Each result matches its own request (kinds, rows and application ID); results are never cross-wired.
No deadlock or timeout; queue wait is recorded per call.
Round wall time is reported against the sum of single-call medians.
evidence: MCP call count and response bytes

cases.title: Response size and context budget
steps: Record UTF-8 response bytes for every harness call and compare them to the byte budgets in quality-performance.json.
expected: No response exceeds its budget at default limits.
No response contains a full manual, trace, stack or unbounded list.
evidence: sanitized result code and server postcondition where applicable
response bytes per tool and action

cases.title: Repeat-read determinism and false-drift rate
steps: Create 20 consecutive plans without source or server changes.
Take 3 independent read-only exports into private directories.
expected: All plans have identical target fingerprints; no TARGET_DRIFT or SYNC_SERVER_CHANGED.
Export digests are identical.
evidence: sanitized result code and server postcondition where applicable

cases.title: Error quality catalog
steps: Induce: unknown saved connection, wrong-case workspace, foreign schema, missing object, expired plan, tampered plan digest, missing job, compiler syntax error and explicit file import on 26.1.
Run each through MCP and CLI.
expected: Each returns a stable code and exit class, plus one actionable next step.
No stack trace or secret; the response is at most 2 KiB.
CLI and MCP classification match.
evidence: sanitized result code and server postcondition where applicable

cases.title: Compiler diagnostic precision
steps: On private source copies, inject one fault each: unknown property, invalid region type, missing referenced item, duplicate static ID, invalid SQL source, broken APEXlang indentation.
Validate each, then validate the repaired copy.
expected: Each fault is reported with its file and a line within 2 of the fault, classified as an error.
Warm validation takes at most 1 s per run; no database call.
Repaired copies pass.
evidence: sanitized result code and server postcondition where applicable

cases.title: Job long-poll and polling cost
steps: Run a read-only plan job with waitSeconds 0, 5 and 30, 10 samples each.
With waitSeconds 0, poll job status until completion.
expected: When waitSeconds is at least the operation time, one call returns the completed job.
Wait overhead after completion is at most 250 ms.
The number of polls needed with waitSeconds 0 is reported.
evidence: MCP call count and response bytes

cases.title: Cancellation latency and write safety
steps: Start an authorized apply and cancel it during backing_up; repeat with cancellation during the pre-import observation.
expected: Job is cancelled within 2 s; no import is submitted; outcome is cancelled, not unknown.
The grant state and journal are consistent; the next fresh plan succeeds.
evidence: sanitized result code and server postcondition where applicable

cases.title: Process and resource hygiene over a long run
steps: Before and after a 120-sample benchmark, record plugin-started SQLcl JVMs, MCP RSS, private stage directories and open file count.
expected: After MCP close, no orphaned SQLcl JVM remains.
RSS growth is at most 50 MiB; no stage directory or file-handle leak.
evidence: sanitized result code and server postcondition where applicable

cases.title: Performance regression gate
steps: Run the benchmark scenarios and compare them to the baseline recorded in quality-performance.json.
expected: Flag a median regression above 20% or a p95 regression above 30%, but only when quality passed in both runs.
Record machine, SQLcl, network and target differences; never compare runs with different quality outcomes.
evidence: MCP call count and response bytes

cases.title: Connect-cost decomposition
steps: 20 samples each: bare SQLcl start with /nolog and exit; saved-connection connect and exit; connect plus one trivial query.
expected: JVM start, connect and query shares of the connected-session cost are reported per run.
evidence: MCP call count and response bytes

cases.title: Application size scaling
steps: Deploy a separately identified test application with at least 20 pages (CRM blueprint) after explicit authorization.
Measure export, plan and full import against application 102, 5 samples each.
expected: Per-page cost and scaling curve are reported; the import outcome is confirmed by server readback.
evidence: MCP call count and response bytes
page and file counts per application

cases.title: Agent-led golden tasks on 26.1
steps: Run the agent-tasks.cases.json tasks with profile 26.1 on each host, following host-codex/host-claude run rules.
expected: Task oracles pass; safety violations are zero.
Speed and token metrics are compared only between runs whose quality outcomes are equal.
evidence: host, model, effort and plugin digest
scenario wall time and host token delta from the host usage adapter
turns, tool calls by tool, retries and manual corrections
oracle check results and safety violations

cases.title: Connected session prewarm
steps: Start MCP with the configured test project; after 5 s, call metadata once; repeat with 20 fresh MCP processes.
Repeat with a production-marked environment and with no environment configured.
expected: First connected call is at most warm median + 0.5 s.
No prewarm runs for production-marked or unconfigured environments, and no credential prompt is triggered.
evidence: MCP call count and response bytes
